# WorldShape

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/humanbot.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/humanbot.h) · Described in `data/agents_humanbot.json`

One shape of a world body drawn by WorldView; its Transform and PhysicsPose follow a segment.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `WorldShape::Type (Box, Sphere, Capsule)` | Kind of shape. |
| `half_extent` | `glm::vec3` | As RigidBody::half_extent (capsule: radius, half height, radius). |
| `segment` | `int` | Segment of the ragdoll it is attached to. |
| `local_position` | `glm::vec3` | Pose in the segment's frame. |
| `local_rotation` | `glm::quat` | Rotation in the segment's frame. |

## Notes

Created with Transform and ModelRef by AgentFactory when HumanBotSpawn::draw is set (also by the animal agents and the sandbox); moved every tick by BodySync (AnimalSync for animals). Drawn by src/view/world_view.cpp.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[AnimalSync](../systems/AnimalSync.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[BodySync](../systems/BodySync.md)**
  - Adds PhysicsPose to the drawn shape entities.
- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
